The '''Kath''' were a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that shared its name with the [[Waterworld/Legends|ocean world]]<ref name="AIR" /> [[Kath II]], also known simply as Kath,<ref name="YJK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kath system/Legends|Kath system]]</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Kath [[Thlan-sa]] served as an Alliance operative.<ref name="AIR" /> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Shatras]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ssach'thirix]], who only pursued [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] posted on individuals of reptilian species, captured Thlan-sa.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kath species was mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
